FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our web application development services.

FAQcard.title: How long does a web application take to build?
FAQcard.description: Simple web apps take 4–8 weeks. Complex platforms with advanced features, integrations, and custom workflows typically take 3–6 months. We provide detailed timelines during the discovery phase.

FAQcard.title: What technologies do you use for web applications?
FAQcard.description: We use React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and PHP for most projects. For ecommerce we leverage Shopify or WooCommerce where appropriate. We always recommend the best stack for your specific use case.

FAQcard.title: Can you integrate with third-party tools?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We have experience integrating payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), CRMs, ERPs, email platforms, analytics tools, and hundreds of third-party APIs.

FAQcard.title: How do you ensure the application is secure?
FAQcard.description: We follow security best practices including input validation, SQL injection prevention, HTTPS enforcement, role-based access control, and regular dependency audits.

FAQcard.title: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
FAQcard.description: Yes. We offer tiered maintenance and support packages that include bug fixes, performance monitoring, feature updates, and priority response times.
